beats.say: Anthony Ippolito stars as Sylvester Stallone in the ultimate biopic, I Play Rocky.
The upcoming film is directed by Academy Award winner Peter Farrelly.
Distributed by Amazon MGM Studios, this drama brings the legendary story of making Rocky to cinema screens.
The new second trailer gives fans an incredible look at Stallone's classic underdog journey.
You can catch the limited theatrical release starting on 6 November.
The movie then expands everywhere for everyone to see on 20 November.
Will you be watching this story of Sylvester Stallone in cinemas this November?
